#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Unified voice lint: garden rules, site voice, em-dash sanitize, structural slop."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import importlib.util
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SCRIPTS = ROOT / "scripts"


def _load(script: str):
    path = SCRIPTS / f"{script}.py"
    name = script.replace("-", "_")
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
        raise ImportError(path)
    mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules[name] = mod
    spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
    return mod


def _run(script: str, argv: list[str]) -> int:
    saved = sys.argv
    sys.argv = [script] + argv
    try:
        return int(_load(script).main())
    finally:
        sys.argv = saved

7. `yagni:` `search.js` reimplements grouping/filter instead of `searchIndex()` from core (~20–40 lines). Call `search-core.js`. [`assets/js/search.js`, `assets/js/search-core.js`]
8. `delete:` Legacy level-bullet path + dead `strip_description_from_key_concept` (~50 lines). Keep `level_1..5` render only. [`scripts/notes_content.py`]
9. `yagni:` Duplicate OKF CLI/validate/timestamp/YAML-list parsers (~90 lines across three exporters). One helper in `okf_bundle`. [`scripts/export-okf-bundle.py`, `scripts/export-okf-blog-bundle.py`, `scripts/export-anki-deck.py`]
10. `delete:` Superseded hooks installer (shell). Canonical is `pnpm setup:hooks` → `setupGitHooks.mjs`. [`scripts/setup-git-hooks.sh`]
11. `delete:` Stale `__pycache__` only under `scripts/archive/`. Remove the directory. [`scripts/archive/`]
12. `yagni:` `notes-random-select.js` (44) + unused core exports + duplicate `buildPrompt` in duo/single. Fold into core. [`assets/js/notes-random-*.js`]
13. `yagni:` Alias scripts: `deploy`≡`build`, `local`≡`preview:prod`, `test:*`≡`lint:* --self-check`. Keep one name each. [`package.json`]
14. `yagni:` `previewProd.mjs` / `runPython.mjs` thin wrappers. Inline or drop files; keep `spawnUtil.mjs`. [`scripts/previewProd.mjs`, `scripts/runPython.mjs`]
